controls.help: Size of the editor window.
controls.label: SCALE

options.help: Lowest CPU: fewer modes per voice and no clipper oversampling.
options.name: Eco

options.help: The default balance of detail and CPU.
options.name: Normal

options.help: More modes per voice and more clipper oversampling.
options.name: High

options.help: Most detail and least aliasing, for bouncing. Uses the most CPU.
options.name: Render

options.help: Each key plays the patch at its own pitch. Bowed and scraped exciters follow the envelope, so they fade out even while the key is held.
options.name: Tonal

options.help: Each key plays its own pad, with its own sound and tuning, set up with the kit bar above the keyboard. Keys without a pad are silent.
options.name: Kit

options.help: Like Tonal, but bowed and scraped exciters keep sounding while the key is held (the envelope loops Decay and Sustain). Struck exciters still decay.
options.name: Drone

options.help: Clamps peaks at the ceiling with no added latency.
options.name: Hard

options.help: Turns peaks down smoothly ahead of time. Adds about 1 ms of latency.
options.name: Lookahead

controls.help: Final output level, in dB. The ceiling still limits the peaks.
controls.label: OUTPUT

controls.help: Stereo width of the voices. Higher spreads them wider.
controls.label: WIDTH

controls.help: Level of the resonating body under the sound. Higher sounds fuller and more physical.
controls.label: BODY

controls.help: Makes everything heavier: exciter weights and object size. Higher sounds bigger and lower.
controls.label: MASS

controls.help: Wears the object down: more damping and rust. Higher sounds older and duller.
controls.label: CORROSION

controls.help: Pushes drive, chaos and damage. Higher sounds harsher and more broken.
controls.label: VIOLENCE

controls.help: Opens the filter and brightens the object. Higher sounds brighter.
controls.label: BRIGHTNESS

options.help: Fleshy Kelvin-Voigt impact with heavy damping and an explicit mute tail.
options.name: Hand Strike

options.help: Soft non-linear mallet with a compressive felt layer over a harder core.
options.name: Felt Mallet

options.help: Rigid Hertzian strike tuned around mass, brightness, and bounce suppression.
options.name: Hard Mallet

options.help: Light rigid impact with explicit rebound energy and micro-bounce count.
options.name: Drumstick

options.help: Impulse-cloud brush model with density, spread, stiffness, and stochastic variance.
options.name: Wire Brush

options.help: Bi-directional pipe impact with a ringing exciter body feeding back into the collision.
options.name: Metal Pipe

options.help: Clustered heavy-link impacts with separate timing spread and high-frequency rattle coloration.
options.name: Metal Chain

options.help: Smooth stick-slip bow friction with pressure, speed, grip, and slip controls from the documented bow model.
options.name: Bow

options.help: Rigid point scrape where chatter pitch and damping define the squeal character.
options.name: Stiff Point Scrape

options.help: Heavy rough drag with separate baseline force, tearing grit, and noise color.
options.name: Heavy Grinding

options.help: Drag motion across ridges with explicit spacing, depth, and moving contact mass.
options.name: Corrugated Drag

options.help: Integrate-and-fire creak model driven by pull speed, threshold, randomness, and crack sharpness.
options.name: Tension Rise

options.help: Band-limited turbulence exciter shaped by nozzle focus and overload chaos.
options.name: Pneumatic Jet

options.help: Continuous Lorentz-force injection with direct control of mains pitch, proximity, and sag.
options.name: Electromagnetic Hum

options.help: Hook-and-release mechanism with explicit pull distance, stiffness, and break force.
options.name: Tension Snap

options.help: Continuous debris cloud controlled by flow density, particle weight, and variance.
options.name: Particle Rain

controls.help: How hard the exciter presses on the object. Higher drives the object harder: louder and more strained.
controls.label: Pressure

controls.help: How fast the exciter moves across or against the object. Higher sounds brighter and more agitated.
controls.label: Speed

controls.help: Irregularity of the contact. Higher adds grit, noise and jitter to the excitation.
controls.label: Roughness

slots.help: Weight of the striking hand. Heavier hands push more low end into the object.
slots.label: Hand Mass

slots.help: Stiffness of the hand's flesh at contact. Higher gives a shorter, brighter slap.
slots.label: Flesh Stiffness

slots.help: How much the flesh absorbs the impact. Higher softens the attack.
slots.label: Flesh Damping

slots.help: How long the hand rests on the object after the strike. Lower mutes the ring sooner.
slots.label: Mute Decay

slots.help: Weight of the mallet head. Heavier mallets stay in contact longer and bring out the low modes.
slots.label: Mallet Mass

slots.help: Weight of the mallet head. Heavier mallets stay in contact longer and bring out the low modes.
slots.label: Mallet Mass

slots.help: Softness of the felt covering. Higher gives a rounder, darker strike.
slots.label: Felt Softness

slots.help: Hardness of the mallet's core under the felt. Higher adds a brighter click to loud hits.
slots.label: Core Hardness

slots.help: How quickly the felt stiffens as it is squeezed. Higher makes hard hits much brighter than soft ones.
slots.label: Compression Curve

slots.help: Stiffness of the mallet head. Higher gives a sharper, brighter strike.
slots.label: Material Stiffness

slots.help: Energy lost in the contact itself. Higher softens and shortens the attack.
slots.label: Impact Damping

slots.help: Weight of the drumstick. Heavier sticks drive the object harder and darker.
slots.label: Stick Mass

slots.help: Stiffness of the stick's tip. Higher gives a sharper, brighter tick.
slots.label: Tip Stiffness

slots.help: How much the stick bounces back after contact. Higher gives livelier, more rebound-rich hits.
slots.label: Restitution Bounciness

slots.help: Maximum number of small rebounds after a strike. Higher allows a buzzier, rattling attack.
slots.label: Micro Bounce Limit

slots.help: Number of wires in the brush. Higher gives a denser, smoother swish.
slots.label: Wire Density

slots.help: How long the brush's wires take to land, in milliseconds. Higher smears the hit into a sweep.
slots.label: Spread Duration

slots.help: Stiffness of the wires (brush wires or spring coils, by model). Higher sounds brighter and tighter.
slots.label: Wire Stiffness

slots.help: Random level variation between wires or hits. Higher sounds looser and more organic.
slots.label: Amplitude Randomization

slots.help: Weight of the striking pipe. Heavier pipes hit harder and darker.
slots.label: Pipe Mass

slots.help: Stiffness of the striking metal. Higher gives a harder, brighter clang.
slots.label: Metal Stiffness

slots.help: Tuning of the striking pipe's own ring. Higher raises its overtone.
slots.label: Pipe Pitch

slots.help: How long the striking pipe's own ring lasts. Higher adds a longer metallic tail to each hit.
slots.label: Pipe Ring Decay

slots.help: Number of links in the dropped chain. Higher gives a longer, busier rattle.
slots.label: Link Count

slots.help: Weight of the dropped chain. Heavier chains hit harder and darker.
slots.label: Chain Mass

slots.help: How spread out in time the links land, in milliseconds. Higher stretches the cascade.
slots.label: Drop Envelope Spread

slots.help: Rattling between the links. Higher adds more clatter to the strike.
slots.label: Internal Rattle

slots.help: Tone of the rattle. Higher is brighter.
slots.label: Rattle Color

slots.help: How hard the bow presses on the object. Higher is louder and grittier, and too much makes it crunch.
slots.label: Bow Pressure

slots.help: How fast the bow moves. Higher gives a brighter, more stable tone.
slots.label: Bow Speed

slots.help: Static friction of the rosin. Higher grips harder, giving a stronger, rougher stick-slip.
slots.label: Rosin Grip

slots.help: How quickly friction falls once the bow slips. Higher gives a sharper, more aggressive tone.
slots.label: Slip Curve

slots.help: How fast the point scrapes along the surface. Higher raises the chatter's pitch and density.
slots.label: Scrape Speed

slots.help: How hard the point presses into the surface. Higher is louder and harsher.
slots.label: Point Pressure

slots.help: Pitch of the stick-slip chatter. Higher sounds squealier.
slots.label: Chatter Pitch

slots.help: How quickly each chatter burst dies away. Higher sounds drier and tighter.
slots.label: Chatter Damping

slots.help: Speed of the grinding wheel. Higher gives a brighter, denser roar.
slots.label: Grind Speed

slots.help: How hard the grinder presses on the object. Higher is louder and more aggressive.
slots.label: Grind Pressure

slots.help: Coarseness of the ground surface. Higher adds noise and crackle.
slots.label: Surface Grit

slots.help: Tone of the grit noise. Higher is brighter.
slots.label: Grit Color

slots.help: How fast the exciter drags across the ridges. Higher raises the ridge rate.
slots.label: Drag Speed

slots.help: Distance between the surface's ridges. Higher spaces the ticks further apart.
slots.label: Ridge Spacing

slots.help: Depth of the ridges. Higher gives stronger, louder ticks.
slots.label: Ridge Depth

slots.help: Weight of the dragged exciter. Heavier sounds lower and heavier.
slots.label: Exciter Mass

slots.help: How fast the tension builds. Higher makes creaks come faster.
slots.label: Pull Speed

slots.help: Tension at which the material slips. Higher builds more tension before each creak.
slots.label: Break Threshold

slots.help: Randomness of the slips. Higher sounds more irregular.
slots.label: Slip Stochasticity

slots.help: Sharpness of each creak. Higher sounds brighter and more percussive.
slots.label: Creak Sharpness

slots.help: Pressure of the air jet. Higher is louder and more turbulent.
slots.label: Air Pressure

slots.help: Width of the nozzle. Higher gives a broader, darker hiss.
slots.label: Nozzle Width

slots.help: Instability of the airflow. Higher sounds rougher and more chaotic.
slots.label: Turbulence Chaos

slots.help: Frequency of the electromagnetic drive, in hertz. It sets the hum's base pitch.
slots.label: Mains Frequency

slots.help: How close the coil sits to the object. Higher couples more strongly and sounds louder.
slots.label: Coil Proximity

slots.help: Instability of the supply. Higher makes the hum waver and sag.
slots.label: Voltage Sag

slots.help: How far the hook pulls before releasing. Higher gives a bigger snap.
slots.label: Pull Distance

slots.help: Stiffness of the hook. Higher gives a sharper release.
slots.label: Hook Stiffness

slots.help: Force of the release. Higher is louder and harder.
slots.label: Snap Force

slots.help: How many particles fall per second. Higher gives a denser rain.
slots.label: Flow Rate

slots.help: Weight of each particle. Heavier particles hit harder and darker.
slots.label: Particle Mass

slots.help: Variation in particle weight. Higher sounds more uneven.
slots.label: Mass Variance

controls.help: How much the envelope shapes the excitation. Lower flattens it.
controls.label: Env Amount

controls.help: How much velocity changes the envelope's peak. Higher makes soft notes quieter.
controls.label: Vel To Peak

controls.help: Scales every envelope time. Higher slows the whole envelope.
controls.label: Global Time

controls.help: How much velocity changes the note's level. Higher gives more dynamic range.
controls.label: Vel To Level

controls.help: How much velocity shortens the envelope. Higher makes hard notes snappier.
controls.label: Vel To Time

controls.help: Shape of the envelope's segments. Turning it away from the middle bends them more.
controls.label: Curve

controls.help: Time the note takes to reach full level. Higher fades in slower.
controls.label: Attack

controls.help: Time the note takes to reach full level. Higher fades in slower.
controls.label: Attack

controls.help: Time to fade after the note ends. Higher fades longer.
controls.label: Release

controls.help: Time to fade after the note ends. Higher fades longer.
controls.label: Release

controls.help: Length of the onset stage that starts the friction envelope. Higher eases the note in slower.
controls.label: Onset

controls.help: Level of the friction envelope's onset stage. Higher starts the note stronger.
controls.label: Onset Lvl

controls.help: Time the note takes to reach full level. Higher fades in slower.
controls.label: Attack

controls.help: Time the envelope holds at its peak before decaying. Higher holds longer.
controls.label: Hold

controls.help: Time to fall from the peak to the sustain level. Higher decays slower.
controls.label: Decay

controls.help: Level held while the note is down. Higher stays louder.
controls.label: Sustain

controls.help: Time to fade after the note ends. Higher fades longer.
controls.label: Release

options.help: The envelope plays once.
options.name: Off

options.help: The envelope repeats between the Start and End stages.
options.name: Forward

options.help: The envelope runs back and forth between the Start and End stages.
options.name: Ping-Pong

controls.help: The stage where the envelope loop begins.
controls.label: Start

controls.help: The stage where the envelope loop ends.
controls.label: End

controls.help: Time to fall from the peak to the sustain level. Higher decays slower.
controls.label: Decay

controls.help: Level held while the note is down. Higher stays louder.
controls.label: Sustain

options.help: Longitudinal pipe response with dedicated length, diameter, and sustain controls.
options.name: Pipe

options.help: 2D plate response balancing overall span, aspect ratio, and material stiffness.
options.name: Plate

options.help: Shell-and-cavity behavior with volume, wall thickness, cavity balance, and shell decay.
options.name: Tank

options.help: Linked resonator behavior shaped by link weight, chain length, instability, and friction loss.
options.name: Chain

options.help: Beam-like modes with explicit mass, shear density, and rigidity damping emphasis.
options.name: I-Beam

options.help: Stiff string response with tension, braid stiffness, and dynamic pitch-drop control.
options.name: Taut Cable

options.help: Dispersive spring response controlled by coil length, chirp density, and slosh instability.
options.name: Coil Spring

options.help: Thin-sheet response with size, thinness, and edge damping rather than generic brightness knobs.
options.name: Sheet Metal

options.help: Circular blade behavior with radius, tooth dissonance, and blade thickness control.
options.name: Industrial Cog

slots.help: Length of the pipe. Longer pipes sound lower.
slots.label: Pipe Length

slots.help: Size of the plate. Larger plates sound lower.
slots.label: Plate Size

slots.help: Size of the tank. Larger tanks sound lower.
slots.label: Tank Size

slots.help: Size of the chain. Larger chains sound lower.
slots.label: Chain Size

slots.help: Weight of the beam. Heavier beams sound lower.
slots.label: Beam Mass

slots.help: Length of the cable. Longer cables sound lower.
slots.label: Cable Length

slots.help: Length of the coil. Longer coils sound lower.
slots.label: Coil Length

slots.help: Size of the sheet. Larger sheets sound lower.
slots.label: Sheet Size

slots.help: Radius of the cog. Larger cogs sound lower.
slots.label: Blade Radius

slots.help: Diameter of the pipe. Higher sounds lower and hollower.
slots.label: Tube Diameter

slots.help: How long the friction envelope sustains in Drone and looped modes. Higher sustains longer.
slots.label: Sustain Time

slots.help: How long the shell rings. Higher sustains longer.
slots.label: Shell Decay

slots.help: Decay time of the friction envelope. Higher fades the friction slower.
slots.label: Friction Decay

slots.help: Damping of the beam's stiffness. Higher shortens the high modes.
slots.label: Rigidity Damping

slots.help: Damping at the sheet's edges. Higher shortens the ring.
slots.label: Edge Damping

slots.help: Thickness of the cog. Higher sounds brighter and stiffer.
slots.label: Blade Thickness

slots.help: Ratio of the plate's sides. Changes how its modes are spread, from even to clustered.
slots.label: Plate Aspect

slots.help: Stiffness of the plate. Higher spreads its overtones and sounds brighter.
slots.label: Plate Stiffness

slots.help: Volume of the tank. Higher sounds lower and boomier.
slots.label: Tank Volume

slots.help: Level of the air cavity's resonance. Higher sounds hollower.
slots.label: Cavity Mix

slots.help: Weight of each chain link. Heavier links sound lower and heavier.
slots.label: Link Mass

slots.help: How much the links shift against each other. Higher sounds looser and more chaotic.
slots.label: Instability

slots.help: Strength of the beam's shear modes. Higher adds more inharmonic overtones.
slots.label: Shear Density

slots.help: Stiffness of the cable's braid. Higher sounds brighter and less harmonic.
slots.label: Braid Stiffness

slots.help: How much the pitch drops on loud notes. Higher bends loud notes down further.
slots.label: Tension Drop

slots.help: How much the spring smears high frequencies. Higher gives a stronger springy chirp.
slots.label: Dispersion Chirp

slots.help: Wobble of the spring. Higher sounds looser and more liquid.
slots.label: Spring Slosh

slots.help: Thinness of the sheet. Higher bends and warps the sound more.
slots.label: Metal Thinness

slots.help: Detuning of the cog's teeth. Higher sounds more dissonant.
slots.label: Tooth Dissonance

controls.help: Opens the filter and brightens the object. Higher sounds brighter.
controls.label: Brightness

controls.help: Corrodes the object: shortens the decay and dulls the upper modes. Higher sounds duller and drier.
controls.label: Rust

controls.help: Dents and cracks the object: detunes its modes and adds buzzing companions. Higher sounds more broken.
controls.label: Damage

controls.help: Heats the metal: lowers its pitch, darkens it and adds a slow warble. Higher is hotter.
controls.label: Heat

controls.help: Coats the object in sludge. Higher damps it and dulls the attack.
controls.label: Sludge

controls.help: Thickness of the object. Higher sounds brighter and stiffer.
controls.label: Thickness

controls.help: Where the exciter hits the object. Moving it changes which modes ring, so the timbre changes.
controls.label: Strike Pos

controls.help: How strongly the exciter and object push each other. Higher makes their interaction stronger and wilder.
controls.label: Coupling

controls.help: How much the strike position drifts while the note plays. Higher makes the timbre move more.
controls.label: Pos Wander

controls.help: Speed of the strike position's drift. Higher wanders faster.
controls.label: Wander Rate

controls.help: How much the envelope sweeps the strike position. Higher gives a stronger timbral sweep.
controls.label: Pos Env

controls.help: How firmly the fundamental keeps its pitch while other modes move. Higher keeps notes more in tune.
controls.label: Anchor

controls.help: Cutoff of the low-pass filter after the voices. Lower sounds darker.
controls.label: Cutoff

controls.help: Resonant peak at the cutoff. Higher rings and whistles more.
controls.label: Resonance

controls.help: Random component drift in the filter. Higher sounds less precise and more analogue.
controls.label: Tolerance

controls.help: Saturation of the Lorenz drive in the post chain. Higher sounds more distorted.
controls.label: Drive Amt

controls.help: Starves the drive's supply now and then. Higher makes it sag and sputter more often.
controls.label: Bias Starve

controls.help: How much the Lorenz attractor modulates the drive. Higher makes the distortion move unpredictably.
controls.label: Chaos

controls.help: Master drive on the voice mix, before the post chain. Higher saturates more.
controls.label: Legacy Drive

controls.help: Material of the body that resonates with the sound. Changes the body's tone.
controls.label: Chassis Mat

controls.help: Size of the body. Higher gives lower, slightly louder resonances.
controls.label: Chassis Vol

controls.help: Stereo spread of the image. Higher sounds wider.
controls.label: Spread

controls.help: How close the listener sits. Higher sounds nearer and fuller.
controls.label: Proximity

options.help: No Space effect: the sound stays dry.
options.name: Off

options.help: A large factory hall reverb.
options.name: Factory

options.help: A spring reverb tank with its twang and chirp.
options.name: Spring

options.help: A modulated stereo echo, free or synced to the host tempo.
options.name: Echo

controls.help: Mix of the Space effect. Higher sounds wetter.
controls.label: Amount

controls.help: Size of the factory room. Higher gives a longer, bigger reverb.
controls.label: Factory Size

controls.help: Clutter in the factory room. Higher adds busier, denser reflections.
controls.label: Machinery

controls.help: Hardness of the walls. Higher sounds brighter and more reflective.
controls.label: Wall Impedance

controls.help: Tension of the reverb spring. Higher raises its twang.
controls.label: Spring Tension

controls.help: Stiffness of the wires (brush wires or spring coils, by model). Higher sounds brighter and tighter.
controls.label: Wire Stiffness

controls.help: Size of the tank. Larger tanks sound lower.
controls.label: Tank Size

controls.help: Locks the echo to the host tempo. Off leaves it on Delay Time.
controls.label: Sync

controls.help: Time between echoes. Higher spaces them further apart.
controls.label: Delay Time

controls.help: How much the echo's delay wobbles. Higher sounds more warped.
controls.label: Movement

controls.help: Darkens each echo repeat. Higher rolls off more highs.
controls.label: HF Damping

controls.help: The output's maximum level. Lower clips the diode stage and limiter earlier.
controls.label: Ceiling

controls.help: Knee of the diode stage. 0 clips hard; higher bends earlier and sounds warmer.
controls.label: Softness

controls.help: Clips the negative half earlier. Higher adds even harmonics and a fuller grit.
controls.label: Asymmetry
